title: Phase 4.5: Observed Budget Architecture
scope: Define the TokenUsage contract (schema + normative doc) as a new, additive 1.0 sidecar keyed against an existing AgentSession, never modifying AgentSession itself.

Define the ObservedBudget contract (schema + normative doc) as a generated report combining AgentSession, TokenUsage, and ObligationLedger into a per-obligation juxtaposition of observed invocation count, elapsed time, and tokens against the ledger's existing status.
Record the approved human gate decisions in ADR-0009.
nonGoals: Implementation code for the budget CLI operation.
Fixtures or tests for TokenUsage or ObservedBudget.

Any change to AgentSession, GateOutcome, AdvisoryResult, AdvisoryDivergenceReport, ObligationLedger, eventBudget, benchmark, Evaluator, SessionEvaluator, existing CLI behavior, or diagnostics PT000-PT706.
Network access, model calls, persistence beyond a single invocation, shadow mode, automatic stopping or escalation, pricing or cost-in-dollars fields, and cross-session aggregation.
Any efficiency, waste, over-budget, or under-budget verdict.
The separate implementation task contract for TokenUsage/ObservedBudget, to be created later, not by this task.

obligations.description: Author ADR-0009 recording the approved observed-budget architecture decision, including the fifteen approved human-gate points, PT800-PT899 diagnostic allocation, and allowed/protected paths.

Author contracts/token-usage.schema.json: schemaVersion 1.0, required sessionId/taskContractId/records at the document level. Each records[] entry requires sessionId, invocationId, sequence, tokensTotal (nonnegative bounded integer, 0..2147483647), producerType (closed four-value enum agent/harness/operator/adapter), producerName, producerVersion (string or null), evidenceBasis (closed four-value enum provider-usage-field/harness-metered/agent-self-reported/adapter-inference). records may be empty.

Author docs/contracts/token-usage.md covering scope, required fields, record admissibility (sessionId/invocationId/sequence cross-validated against the paired AgentSession, mirroring GateOutcome's existing admissibility rule), provenance fields, zero-distinct-from-missing semantics for tokensTotal, missing-record handling, fail-closed behavior, CLI boundary, non-goals, security (including the provenance/truth-verification caveat), ownership, and compatibility.

Author contracts/observed-budget.schema.json: schemaVersion 1.0, required sessionId/taskContractId/ledgerTraceId/generatedAt/sourceDigest/obligations. generatedAt is a fixed const sentinel (1970-01-01T00:00:00.0000000Z), not wall-clock. obligations is non-empty (minItems 1), ordered exactly as the paired ObligationLedger's obligations array; each entry requires obligationId, ledgerStatus (existing five-value ledger status enum), observedInvocationCount (nonnegative bounded integer), observedElapsedMillis (64-bit nonnegative integer, never null), observedTokensTotal (64-bit nonnegative integer or null). No efficiency/waste/applicability field of any kind.

Author docs/contracts/observed-budget.md covering scope (three mandatory inputs: session-path, token-usage-path, ledger-path), cross-reference rules between the three inputs, per-obligation observation derivation (invocation count and elapsed time from AgentSession only, tokens from TokenUsage), invocation window validation, missing-token-record handling and the PT806 non-blocking precedent, overflow behavior, the explicit absence of any efficiency/waste verdict, fail-closed behavior, determinism (fixed generatedAt sentinel and fixed-order sourceDigest), CLI, non-goals, security (including the provenance/truth-verification caveat), ownership, and compatibility.

constraints: TokenUsage is a new, additive 1.0 sidecar; contracts/agent-session.schema.json and docs/contracts/agent-session.md are never modified.
observedInvocationCount is derived from validated AgentSession invocations only, never from TokenUsage or ObligationLedger.
observedElapsedMillis is the sum of validated per-invocation endedAt-startedAt durations; it is a 64-bit nonnegative integer and is never null.
TokenUsage.records[] entries are keyed and cross-validated by sessionId, invocationId, sequence against the paired AgentSession, reusing GateOutcome's existing admissibility rule.
Each TokenUsage.records[] entry carries producerType, producerName, producerVersion, evidenceBasis provenance.
tokensTotal is a nonnegative bounded integer (0..2147483647); zero is a distinct, valid, present value from a missing record.

A missing token record yields an informational PT806 diagnostic per invocation and forces null for any observedTokensTotal that would sum a missing constituent; a missing constituent is never silently dropped from the sum.
Arithmetic overflow, in either aggregate sum (observedElapsedMillis or observedTokensTotal), fails closed (PT804) rather than wrapping, truncating, or saturating.
ObservedBudget requires AgentSession, TokenUsage, and ObligationLedger; the ledger is mandatory, never optional.
ObservedBudget.obligations[] juxtaposes observed invocation count, tokens, and elapsed time next to the existing ledger-declared status; it renders no efficiency or waste verdict.
The CLI verb is budget, taking exactly session-path, token-usage-path, ledger-path, and an optional --out.
PT800-PT899 is explicitly allocated to this phase's diagnostics; PT806 is reserved for the missing-token-record informational condition.
generatedAt on ObservedBudget is the fixed sentinel 1970-01-01T00:00:00.0000000Z, not a wall-clock timestamp.
sourceDigest is the SHA-256 digest over the normalized AgentSession, TokenUsage, and ObligationLedger, concatenated in that fixed order.
obligations[] is ordered exactly as the paired ObligationLedger.obligations[] array.
ObservedBudget is local and read-only: no network access, no model call, no persistence, no shadow mode, no auto-stop, no pricing or cost-in-dollars field, no cross-session aggregation.

No change to AgentSession, GateOutcome, AdvisoryResult, AdvisoryDivergenceReport, ObligationLedger, eventBudget, benchmark, Evaluator, SessionEvaluator, existing CLI behavior, or diagnostics PT000-PT706.
